checks: The characteristic primary decomposition and ell-power filtration are invariant under the actual cyclic-band monodromy. Every rank-one F_ell quotient is trivialized by a cover of degree dividing ell-1, so averaging is valid even if the geometric characteristic divides that degree.
Cartan-Leray and constant affine H2 vanishing give H2=0 for each rank-one quotient. The long exact sequence uses only degree-two vanishing of subobject and quotient; no hidden H3 vanishing is needed.
The universal finite-etale-cover tower kills H1 by finite torsors after trivializing the coefficient sheaf. The five-term group-to-scheme H2 injection preserves the actual action.
The semilinear lifting obstruction has coefficient module Fq*(chi); continuous finite-image lift cocycles are killed by the proved H2 statement, retaining the field projection and continuity.

On the actual cyclic field cover of Omega((t)), the maps q_x-1 and T=(q-1)/(q_x-1) give both cyclic H1 and H2 equal to zero by exact kernel/image cardinalities. No division by the field-image order occurs.

The Kummer valuation isomorphism on Omega((s)) is deck-invariant because every geometric deck automorphism preserves valuation. The residual coefficient action is multiplication by q_x, giving exactly q_x-1 invariants.

Two lifts differ by a continuous crossed scalar character; scalar conjugacy is exactly the coboundary relation. Projective conjugation can be lifted to GL over the same finite field, so the same upper bound applies to projective conjugacy classes.
The trivial module and q=2 cases are included; local lift existence is not asserted independently of the affine-curve application.
